title: Alexandria funeral bands, Buddy Bowler and Luther Denny
summary: French played makeshift funeral bands in Alexandria; talk of Buddy Bowler, Luther Denny's music shop and Glasscocks.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I know what I wanted to ask you before I forget it. What about Alexandria? Did you play in any brass bands there?

I did. I played in a funeral. I didn't have them on, but seven or eight pieces. Just scrap up or anything, just to make a noise behind them. I don't know if I was a person who died. What are the words threaten like? You know old Buddy Bowler?
No, I never did see him. You don't know Buddy Bowler?
Never seen him in my life. Well, he died up there. We played for him. You don't know, you know Luther Denny?
Luther Denny up there, you know, at least, you see that music shop, every fan.
I didn't miss Buddy Bowler as much, but I didn't ever see him because when I went to Northean to see it went crazy or something, I don't know. Yeah, he died.
He died up in Alexandria, Buddy Bowler?
No, he died in the only, in Baltimore, at Alexandria.
Did you play for his funeral? No, they didn't have no music.

You ever been to Alexandria, Alexandria, to see the Luther Denny? No, I never heard of him. He got a music shop on, at least, you couldn't miss him or save him, like, got a big music shop on, he was a fan. I don't care how the bad he is, he straightened him out. He did, he did do that, he got a music shop. I ain't know everybody who could name him. He got a big piece, I don't know how.
Was he there the time of World War I?
Was he there the time of World War I? Yeah. Well, I don't know if I should go.
Luther Denny, he got a music shop on Lee Street.

On Lee Street? Yeah. Well, you know where I used to go play? Remember that place called Glasscocks? Yeah. Up on Lee Street. Yeah. In Alexandria. They used to have a place that is called Glasscocks. You go around and go upstairs. And I used to go up there and play. You play for that, for the Sky Roof Garden?

Yeah. Yeah, Sky Roof Garden. But they ain't there no more. No? No, they got Club Almag there. Club 20. And the Simon, I'm gonna say what are the clubs? They got a big club there on 2nd Street too. Yeah, they got some big clubs there. And you go across that Bayer, they got some clubs, they got two, three clubs out there. They don't run every night. Every night.
